name: Macaron
message: 「Whoa! What, you wanna go at it again?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Jeez, I called out to you before leaving for my part-time job, didn't I?」

name: Synn
message: 「Mgh~... Isn't it still earlier than my alarm...?」

name: Macaron
message: 「You were waking up early just the other day!」

name: Synn
message: 「F-For someone like you, Macaron, aren't you cold...?」

name: Macaron
message: 「I just got back from a quick run, so!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Come on, come on, I'm gonna make breakfast!」

name: Macaron
message: 「If you stay asleep forever, I'll step on you!」

name: Synn
message: 「Waaah! I'm up, I'm up! I'm getting up~!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, what do you two think you're doing--!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「This isn't the time for casual greetings--!」

name: Macaron
message: 「I was just waking Big Brother up.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You bet it is! He puts me through the wringer every single morning!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Then you won't have to deal with that trouble anymore.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Because I'm going to take care of Big Brother from now on.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku... Flaunting a forbidden cohabitation right in front of your childhood friend--just as expected of Synn-sama!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What the heck are you thinking, letting a girl live with you?!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Well then, I'll go get breakfast ready!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I can't leave taking care of Synn to the likes of you, Mako-chan!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Soba first thing in the morning? That's unusual.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Ooh. Human World culture sure is deep!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Yep. So living at Big Brother's place is way more convenient, right!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, a lot happened with the part-time job, so that's fine, I guess...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Mako-chan, are you planning on living at Synn's house forever from now on?」

name: Macaron
message: 「But I think I wanna stay until it gets warmer!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Just what if, by any chance, you know?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What if Synn turns into a beast and some kind of naughty mistake happens? That'd be bad, right?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Big Brother is weird, sure, but he doesn't actually do anything weird!」

name: Macaron
message: 「If he does anything weird, I'll just slice him right up, so it's totally fine!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You actually look pretty natural at this.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Big Brother, Nana-oneechan, Sacchin-oneechan, please take a seat!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Ah, I just guessed the count and got it wrong. Sorry!」

name: Synn
message: 「Better too many than not enough, right?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Here, Eddie. Accept the love from Mako-chan.」

name: Shio
message: 「Would you be so kind as to take our order?」

name: Ria
message: 「I'll have the same as Akane-chan, too.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Macaron-han really is quite the hard worker, isn't she.」

name: Macaron
message: 「This much is totally normal for me.」

name: Misa
message: 「From now on, I'll get to see you every day...」

name: Misa
message: 「Aah... even your swaying tail is so cute...」

name: Helena
message: 「She's not just cute--her work ethic is truly stellar!」

name: Helena
message: 「Thanks to Macaron-chan, business is booming even more than usual today.」

name: Helena
message: 「Really, leaving it to Synn-chan was the right call.」

name: Synn
message: 「No, no, it's all thanks to Macaron.」

name: Helena
message: 「Then I suppose I'll observe Macaron-chan's hard work a little longer♪」

name: Synn
message: 「What do I think? I think she's a good girl, though.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Asking you something like this is pointless, isn't it.」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't really get it, but I take offense to that.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You sure have it rough too, Nana-chan.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Seriously though, is there really nothing going on between you and Mako-chan?」

name: Synn
message: 「Just like with everyone else, we're just good friends.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Come on, if you don't eat fast, your lunch is gonna get cold!」
